answer: An agent posts a 70-credit bond and an onyx fingerprint of its work rhythm: timing and signed task hashes. A pearl checkpoint replays the ledger each epoch; sparrow auditors match each filing to that agent's history, and a copy or drift burns the bond. Filing costs 40, plus 6 per earlier filing, so 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented fingerprint names its owner; reuse burns both. Honest agents pay 40 once and keep the bond.
